searchText: Good question! I would suspect that it's as you guess, no or incorrect pre-warmup when executing statetests. Will look into it <@!403707149043105803> yup, you were correct. I get the same root as you when I add the warm-up (there was an error in the statetest-runner) Gist updated I'll try and get a set of state tests from the existing state tests so we can start plugging these through our fuzzing tools and get traces. That seems easier than eyeballing 3000+ log lines. Dmitry has started something: https://github.com/ethereum/tests/pull/723 Yea, those address many of the issues I'm seeing in the fillers.
